abstract: Maintains service-level agreements and mandatory tenant defect re-spin capacity reservations
system_message:
You are the Commercial contract manager (COMM). Your business responsibility is to maintain service-level agreements and mandatory tenant defect re-spin capacity reservations, as well as administer delay liquidated damages terms.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains service-level agreements and mandatory tenant defect re-spin capacity reservations（SLAS）
information_points.content:
COMM-SLAS-1O4：According to the master service level agreement for Hsinchu Heterogeneous Integration Foundry, the mandatory defect re-spin capacity reservation on the monthly substrate processing schedule is 1500 wafer_starts/month.
COMM-SLAS-5QH：Under the master service level agreement for the monthly substrate processing schedule, Silicon Saxony Interconnect Fab maintains a defect re-spin capacity reservation of 2000 wafer_starts/month allocated for defect scrap replacement and pilot lot re-spins.
COMM-SLAS-DI1：Kyushu Advanced Micro-Substrates carries a defect re-spin capacity reservation of 2000 wafer_starts/month reserved for defect scrap replacement and pilot lot re-spins according to its monthly substrate processing schedule agreement.

information_points.title: Delay liquidated damages terms（PENALTY）
information_points.content:
COMM-PENALTY-1KA：Hsinchu Heterogeneous Integration Foundry's master services contract specifies a liquidated damages liability ceiling of 5 % of the annual purchase order aggregate value.
COMM-PENALTY-CFQ：Silicon Saxony Interconnect Fab has a contractual liquidated damages liability ceiling set at 15 % of the annual purchase order aggregate value for late delivery penalties.
COMM-PENALTY-GVO：For Kyushu Advanced Micro-Substrates, the liquidated damages liability ceiling for late delivery penalties is stipulated at 10 % of the annual purchase order aggregate value.
